initial_prompt: What's the difference between crocodiles and alligators?

messages.content: What's the difference between crocodiles and alligators?

The easiest way to tell them apart is the snout shape—alligators have wide, U-shaped snouts while crocodiles have narrower, V-shaped ones. When their mouths are closed, you can see a crocodile's fourth tooth on the lower jaw sticking out, but an alligator's teeth are hidden. Crocodiles also tend to be more aggressive and live in saltwater habitats, while alligators prefer freshwater and are generally less confrontational toward humans.
